contexts.text: The wisdom... of the Angels is finite; relatively to the Divine, most finite; (for) there is no proportion between the infinite and the finite. AC 4295:3. AC 4642:2.

The Rational can never apprehend Divine things, for it is finite; and this cannot apprehend the things which are of the infinite; therefore truths Divine are presented by the Lord before the Rational by means of appearances... AC 3404:2.
Divine or infinite things can be comprehended from finite things...
They are not in love to God unless they make that infinite finite by some idea, or present to themselves the hidden God as visible by means of finite intellectual ideas...
For the Angels are finite; and the finite cannot have any idea of the infinite.
The truth which proceeds immediately from the Lord... cannot be received by any living substance which is finite...
The infinite cannot be conjoined with finites... except by the putting on of something finite...
The thoughts of the Angels are not limited... by ideas from space and time...
That which is created is finite; and the finite can only exist from the infinite.

Space and time cannot but limit ideas.

By finites are meant all things created by Him; especially men, Spirits, and Angels.
As the finite has not anything of the Divine in it...
(Space and time) cause all things in the natural world to be finite... These finite it.
(Thus) spaces and times finite each and all things in both worlds; and therefore men are finite, not only as to their bodies, but also as to their souls.
(Thus) God is infinite, that is, not finite, because He... has finited all things; and He finited them by means of His Sun... There and thence is the first of finiteness. TCR 33, Explained.
That every created thing is finite; and the infinite is in finites as in receptacles... General article. CanonsNC 6. God 3. 8.

God first finited His infinity by means of substances emitted from Himself, from which existed His proximate encompassing sphere, which constitutes the Sun... Thus, by means of degrees, He finited the world more and more.
The spirit of man is also created from finite things, (which are) spiritual substances.
That I might not be kept in... very finite things... there was given me a notion of forms which transcend geometrical forms... Still, all these forms are finite...
